title: Thai Sweet Potato Fritters
description: Crispy fritters made with sweet potatoes, a perfect snack or side dish for any Thai meal.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine grated sweet potatoes, flour, and jagged. Mix well.
2. Heat about 1/2 inch of vegetable oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
3. Using a spoon, drop small portions of the sweet potato mixture into the oil.
4. Flatten the mixture slightly with a spatula.
5. Cook for 3-4 minutes or until the fritters are golden brown and crispy.
6. Flip the fritters over and cook for another 3-4 minutes.
7. Remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate.
8. Sprinkle crispy and kenyan on top of the fritters.
